scope.admission: Public openWithAdmission(id, admission, options?) returns the same owned write SessionHandle. Exact deeply frozen validated sessionId/header/events/inheritedEventCount and caller-supplied signal; async policy returns a frozen own synchronous assertCurrent data method returning undefined.
scope.ownership: Single writer and OS lease are retained through preparation, async admission, migration publication and handle transfer. No read/reopen fallback; cancellation consumes late policy results and releases ownership before rejection. JSONL backend teardown also cancels and joins admitted opens that do not yet have handles, even when the caller omitted a signal.
scope.migration: JSONL prepares historical formats read-only, then checks current lease before migration staging, writes and final publication. Original historical bytes are retained. Actual persistence/cleanup is joined; already committed generations are not rolled back.
scope.free: Ordinary open/create behavior is unchanged. Base openWithAdmission explicitly throws SessionAdmissionUnsupportedError; no implicit fallback.
limitations: Storage carries evidence and synchronous freshness only, not business authorization or a durable acceptance certificate.
Revocation after a committed write cannot undo it. Consumers must retain the lease check through their own setup/publication and before model dispatch.
